What Is Office Interior Design?

Office interior design shapes a workplace so it functions well, reflects the brand and supports the people using it. It starts with understanding how the business works, how teams connect and what clients should experience on arrival.

The design package is the plan: layouts, 3D visuals, material choices and technical drawings. Fit-out is the physical execution. Woodex offers both separately or as one coordinated design and build project.

What We Deliver

A complete office design package, from accurate measurements to the documents your build team needs.

Scroll through the full workplace scope.

01

Site Measurement & Survey

Accurate dimensions, existing services and site conditions recorded before planning.

02

Space Planning & Layout Optimization

Departments, meeting rooms, reception and circulation arranged around how the team works.

03

Concept Design & Mood Board

A clear visual direction that connects the workplace with the brand.

04

Material & Finish Selection

Floors, ceilings, walls and joinery chosen as one practical palette.

05

Ceiling, Lighting & Electrical Layout

False ceiling, lighting and switch points coordinated with each work zone.

06

Furniture Planning & Specification

Workstations, meeting tables and executive desks planned with brand integration.

07

3D Photorealistic Rendering

Review and approve the office before any physical work starts.

08

Working Drawings & BOQ

Technical plans, material schedule and an itemised cost estimate for execution.

Office Design Styles

The right style should support the way the company works, not simply follow a trend. We shape each direction around the brief.

01

Modern Corporate

Polished materials, clear lines and a confident client-facing atmosphere.

02

Industrial

Exposed structure, honest finishes and adaptable open work areas.

03

Contemporary Minimal

Quiet detailing and reduced visual clutter for a focused workplace.

04

Branded & Themed

Colour, graphics and custom details that express the business clearly.

05

Biophilic

Natural light, planting and warm materials that soften the working day.

06

Hybrid Collaborative

Focused desks, team zones and flexible rooms for changing work patterns.

Our Design Process

Five clear stages turn the business brief into an approved, build-ready workplace design.

1

Consultation & Requirements

We learn the team structure, work patterns, brand priorities, budget and target date.

2

Site Measurement

We survey the office, openings, services and existing conditions accurately.

3

Concept & Layout Design

Space planning, circulation and the visual concept take shape for review.

4

Material & Furniture Selection

Finishes, lighting, workstations and custom furniture are coordinated.

5

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Approved 3D views and technical documentation prepare the office for execution.

Typical design timelineTypically 2-4 weeks from brief to approved drawings for a 1,000-2,000 sq ft office; larger projects take longer.
